notes.title: Chickenoidz Super Party Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Steam and its inhabitants. Here comes our page to the world. As you can see from the description of Chikenoidz - we're trying to create something very fun, dynamic and a little crazy. You'll have a chance to play with your friends at some fun party, and if you're a lone wolf or wolfess - you can look for partners for online Chickensparring. We hope, that the game will bring you a lot of positive emotions and a lot of fun nights. We ask two things from you:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427532/0169957ee27f1c783b84e46273d63ceb610134b6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427532/3f4cf70abc4850fab3a6b1915ad367b70908d3e8.jpg[/img][/url]
1. Don't forget to add the game to Wishlist
2. In the discussions for this news, write what you think about the game in general, what you want to see at the release, maybe there is something unnecessary in your opinion. We have created a "base" of the game - where it will go - it's not just up to us, but to you. 
Thanks for your attention and until further news, your RaveGameDev.
